en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a square with a prominent stone fountain or monument at its center, surrounded by low buildings and trees. People and horse-drawn carriages appear in the background. The top of the card contains printed bilingual text in French and English identifying it as a souvenir from Salonica and mentioning 'The White Fountain'. A website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears at the bottom right.
